investigation_a.confidence_definition: maximum softmax probability from each expert's OOF logits

predicted_class_group_signal.signal_definition: map each expert's top-1 predicted class to the canonical class group; true groups are used only for retrospective evaluation

inference_time_inputs: four experts' top-1 predicted class IDs
